name: api-explorer
description: Explores, lints and diffs API descriptions: OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 and Swagger 2.0 from URLs, project files or git revisions (full $ref resolution, URL-to-operation matching, breaking-change diff, request snippets), GraphQL (SDL or introspection), AsyncAPI 2/3 and gRPC .proto files; detects API frameworks and discovers checked-in spec files

envVars.name: API_EXPLORER_ENDPOINTS
envVars.description: Sources to load at startup: a URL or project file path, a comma-separated list, or a JSON array like [{"alias":"api","url":"http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs"},{"alias":"events","path":"docs/asyncapi.yaml"}]. Optional: sources can also be added at runtime with add_api_source.

envVars.name: API_EXPLORER_PROJECT_ROOT
envVars.description: Directory that local spec files, detection scans and git diffs are confined to. Defaults to the server's working directory.

envVars.name: API_EXPLORER_CACHE_TTL
envVars.description: Seconds a spec fetched from a URL or git revision stays cached (local files are re-read as soon as they change).

envVars.name: API_EXPLORER_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: HTTP and git timeout in milliseconds.

envVars.name: API_EXPLORER_RETRY_COUNT
envVars.description: Retries for transient HTTP failures (network errors, timeouts, 5xx, 429).

envVars.name: API_EXPLORER_MAX_SPEC_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum size of a fetched or read document, in bytes.

envVars.name: API_EXPLORER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
envVars.description: Set to 0 to refuse loopback/private-network spec URLs. Cloud metadata (169.254.0.0/16) is always refused.
